Takeaway: Great for tab selection.
Trap: Not for long-term data storage.

cards.title: @FocusState
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: FocusState manages keyboard focus.
Takeaway: Better form UX.
Trap: Forgetting to clear focus leaves keyboard up.

cards.title: Two-way binding loops
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Formatting bindings can create feedback loops.
Takeaway: Separate raw and formatted state.
Trap: Parsing in `set` without guards causes jitter.

cards.title: TextField number input
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Prefer binding to String and parse to number.
Takeaway: Better editing experience.
Trap: Direct binding to Int is awkward and error-prone.

cards.title: Pass data down
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Data flows down the view tree.
Takeaway: Keep parents as owners.
Trap: Global state for everything becomes hard to manage.

cards.title: Send events up
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Send actions up via closures or bindings.
Takeaway: Clear ownership.
Trap: Don’t use NotificationCenter as a default “event bus”.

cards.title: Closure capture cycle
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Closures can capture `self` strongly in classes.
Takeaway: Use weak captures when storing closures.
Trap: Stored closure + self capture = leak.

cards.title: EnvironmentObject caution
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: EnvironmentObject is powerful, use it sparingly.
Takeaway: Great for app session/theme.
Trap: Turning it into a global dumping ground.

cards.title: Enum for UI state
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Prefer enums for screen states.
Takeaway: Avoid impossible combinations.
Trap: Multiple booleans quickly create invalid states.

cards.title: LoadState example
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Model loading as `idle/loading/loaded/failed`.
Takeaway: Cleaner rendering logic.
Trap: Separate `isLoading` + `error` + `data` can desync.

cards.title: Sheet state with item
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `.sheet(item:)` for selected-item sheets.
Takeaway: Fewer state variables.
Trap: Item must be Identifiable.

cards.title: Alert routing with enum
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use an enum for alert content.
Takeaway: One alert source.
Trap: Multiple `alert(isPresented:)` booleans conflict.

cards.title: Threading updates
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Update SwiftUI state on main.
Takeaway: Use @MainActor.
Trap: Background state changes can warn or misbehave.

cards.title: Combine with SwiftUI
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: SwiftUI listens to objectWillChange.
Takeaway: ObservableObject integrates naturally.
Trap: Heavy Combine work on main causes jank.

cards.title: State & Data Flow — Debounce search
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Debounce and cancel old tasks for search.
Takeaway: Correct results order.
Trap: Old responses overriding new ones.

cards.title: Navigation state
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Navigation can be driven by state/path.
Takeaway: Deep links and restoration.
Trap: Keeping navigation state in two places causes desync.

cards.title: NavigationPath basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Path stores Hashable values.
Takeaway: Programmatic navigation.
Trap: Using unstable IDs breaks navigation.

cards.title: Scene restoration
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Restore only UI state, not secrets.
Takeaway: Better UX.
Trap: Persisting sensitive data in SceneStorage.

cards.title: Custom EnvironmentKey
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: You can define custom environment values.
Takeaway: Lightweight DI.
Trap: Too many custom keys makes code hard to follow.

cards.title: PreferenceKey concept
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: PreferenceKeys send values up the tree.
Takeaway: Advanced layout/communication.
Trap: Easy to cause render loops if you mutate state in response.

cards.title: Prevent preference loops
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Don’t blindly set state in `onPreferenceChange`.
Takeaway: Add guards.
Trap: State change triggers layout triggers preference change triggers state…

cards.title: Transactions
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Transactions control animation behavior.
Takeaway: Disable animations when needed.
Trap: Overusing transaction tweaks makes UI inconsistent.

cards.title: Testing state logic
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Test state transitions in view models.
Takeaway: More reliable than UI tests.
Trap: UI tests alone are slow and flaky.

cards.title: Preview different states
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Preview loading/empty/error/loaded states.
Takeaway: Catch edge cases early.
Trap: Only previewing loaded state hides UX bugs.

cards.title: Minimize state
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Keep state minimal; compute the rest.
Takeaway: Less syncing.
Trap: Storing everything leads to bugs and complexity.

cards.title: Avoid hidden side effects
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Keep side effects in explicit places (task/onAppear/actions).
Takeaway: Predictable rendering.
Trap: Side effects in body cause repeated work.

cards.title: Make state explicit
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Name state to match the UI concept.
Takeaway: Easier maintenance.
Trap: Generic names like `flag` become meaningless.

modules.title: 13. Navigation, Lists, Forms
modules.moduleDescription: NavigationStack/path, List patterns, forms, search, refresh, sheets, and UX-safe routing.

cards.title: Navigation is state-driven
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: In SwiftUI, navigation is driven by state.
Takeaway: Model routes and selections explicitly.
Trap: Trying to “push” screens imperatively like UIKit.

cards.title: Navigation, Lists, Forms — NavigationStack
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `NavigationStack` for modern navigation.
Takeaway: Replaces `NavigationView`.
Trap: Mixing old and new navigation APIs creates confusion.

cards.title: NavigationLink basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `NavigationLink` creates a push transition.
Takeaway: Works inside NavigationStack.
Trap: A link outside a stack won’t navigate.

cards.title: Value-based navigation
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `NavigationLink(value:)` with `navigationDestination`.
Takeaway: Lazy and type-safe routing.
Trap: Forgetting `navigationDestination` makes taps do nothing.

cards.title: navigationDestination
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Map values to screens via `.navigationDestination(for:)`.
Takeaway: Centralizes routing.
Trap: Values must be Hashable.

cards.title: NavigationPath
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: NavigationPath stores a stack of Hashable values.
Takeaway: Enables programmatic navigation and deep links.
Trap: Unstable IDs break restoration and routing.

cards.title: Programmatic push
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Append values to `path` to navigate.
Takeaway: Works well for deep links.
Trap: Keeping multiple paths leads to desync.

cards.title: Back navigation
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Pop by removing from path or using dismiss.
Takeaway: Maintain a consistent stack.
Trap: Manually changing UI without updating navigation state.

cards.title: Push vs sheet
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Push for hierarchy, sheet for modal tasks.
Takeaway: Better UX.
Trap: Using sheets everywhere breaks navigation expectations.

cards.title: sheet is state
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `.sheet(isPresented:)` is controlled by Bool state.
Takeaway: Declarative presentation.
Trap: Using a Bool without data forces extra “selected” state.

cards.title: sheet(item:)
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Prefer `.sheet(item:)` for selected-item modals.
Takeaway: One source of truth.
Trap: Item must be Identifiable.

cards.title: fullScreenCover
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use fullScreenCover for flows like onboarding/login.
Takeaway: Full-screen modals.
Trap: Full-screen for minor actions feels heavy.

cards.title: Navigation, Lists, Forms — dismiss
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `@Environment(\.dismiss)` to close.
Takeaway: Works for sheets and navigation.
Trap: Dismiss does nothing if nothing is presented.

cards.title: Toolbar basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Add navigation actions with `.toolbar {}`.
Takeaway: Native navigation bar UX.
Trap: Toolbars depend on being in a navigation context.

cards.title: Toolbar placements
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use placements like `.topBarTrailing`.
Takeaway: Consistent button locations.
Trap: Placement differs across platforms—test iPad/macOS if needed.

cards.title: Navigation title
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `.navigationTitle()` for screen titles.
Takeaway: Clear hierarchy.
Trap: Setting title in nested views can make it unclear where it comes from.

cards.title: Large vs inline titles
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `.navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.large/.inline)`.
Takeaway: Match Apple conventions.
Trap: Large titles on detail screens can feel wrong.

cards.title: List is optimized
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Prefer `List` for large scrolling data.
Takeaway: Built-in cell reuse-like behavior.
Trap: Nesting List in ScrollView causes gesture/layout issues.

cards.title: List + ForEach
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Build lists from Identifiable items.
Takeaway: Stable diffing.
Trap: Using indices as IDs breaks on insert/delete.

cards.title: EditButton
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `EditButton()` toggles list edit mode.
Takeaway: Native editing UI.
Trap: Without onDelete/onMove, edit mode does little.

cards.title: onDelete
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Implement `onDelete` to support swipe-to-delete.
Takeaway: Keep data and UI in sync.
Trap: Deleting UI rows without updating the data source causes crashes.

cards.title: onMove
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Implement `onMove` to reorder.
Takeaway: Update the array accordingly.
Trap: If you don’t update data, order “snaps back”.

cards.title: Swipe actions
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `.swipeActions` for contextual actions.
Takeaway: Good UX.
Trap: Too many swipe actions makes UI noisy.

cards.title: Refreshable
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `.refreshable { await reload() }`.
Takeaway: Pull-to-refresh.
Trap: Avoid starting multiple concurrent reloads.

cards.title: Searchable
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `.searchable(text:)` for search UI.
Takeaway: Native search bar.
Trap: Without debounce/cancel, you’ll spam the network.

cards.title: Navigation, Lists, Forms — Debounce search
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Debounce and cancel old searches.
Takeaway: Correct results ordering.
Trap: Old results overwriting new ones.

cards.title: Section in List
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use Section to group rows.
Takeaway: Better readability.
Trap: Doing heavy grouping logic in body can slow rendering.

cards.title: DisclosureGroup
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: DisclosureGroup expands/collapses content.
Takeaway: Compact sections.
Trap: Keep expanded state stable or it will collapse unexpectedly.

cards.title: Empty states
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Show explicit empty states for lists.
Takeaway: Prevent “looks broken” screens.
Trap: An empty List often feels like a bug.

cards.title: Loading states
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Show ProgressView during loading.
Takeaway: Clear feedback.
Trap: Blocking UI without feedback feels like freezing.

cards.title: Error states
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Show an error message + Retry action.
Takeaway: Users can recover.
Trap: Showing only a toast and leaving blank content.

cards.title: Forms basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Form is best for settings/data entry screens.
Takeaway: Native spacing and behavior.
Trap: Form inside ScrollView can cause conflicts.

cards.title: Form sections
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use Section to structure forms.
Takeaway: Easier scanning.
Trap: One giant form without sections is overwhelming.

cards.title: TextField in forms
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: TextField must bind to state.
Takeaway: Two-way input.
Trap: Validation must not fight the user while typing.

cards.title: Picker tags
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Picker options need tags matching selection type.
Takeaway: Correct selection.
Trap: Mismatched tag types cause selection bugs.

cards.title: DatePicker
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: DatePicker is locale-aware.
Takeaway: Great for forms.
Trap: Test formats/locales; UI varies by region.

cards.title: Stepper
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Stepper is for small increments.
Takeaway: Good for small numeric settings.
Trap: Not great for wide ranges—use slider or input.

cards.title: Focus management
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use @FocusState to move between fields.
Takeaway: Smooth form UX.
Trap: Forgetting to dismiss keyboard blocks buttons.

cards.title: onSubmit
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `.onSubmit` for keyboard submit actions.
Takeaway: Better flow.
Trap: Don’t trigger submits prematurely on focus changes.

cards.title: Keyboard toolbar
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Add a Done button via toolbar if needed.
Takeaway: Easy keyboard dismissal.
Trap: Forgetting dismissal leads to stuck keyboard.

cards.title: Selection in lists
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Keep selection in state.
Takeaway: Useful for iPad split views.
Trap: Selecting by index breaks when data changes.

cards.title: NavigationSplitView
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use NavigationSplitView for iPad/mac master-detail.
Takeaway: Better large-screen UX.
Trap: Behavior differs on iPhone—test both.

cards.title: Detail placeholders
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Provide a placeholder when nothing is selected.
Takeaway: Better split UX.
Trap: Empty detail pane feels broken.

cards.title: Multiple sheets
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Prefer a single sheet state (often an enum or item).
Takeaway: Avoid presentation conflicts.
Trap: Two simultaneous sheets are undefined/confusing.

cards.title: Enum routing
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use enums to represent routes (sheet/alert).
Takeaway: One source of truth.
Trap: Many booleans create inconsistent routing.

cards.title: Confirmation dialog
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `confirmationDialog` for action choices.
Takeaway: Safer destructive actions.
Trap: Destructive actions without confirmation hurt UX.

cards.title: Navigation, Lists, Forms — Context menus
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Context menus are for secondary actions.
Takeaway: Keep primary actions visible.
Trap: Hiding essential actions only in menus.

cards.title: List row insets
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Customize insets carefully.
Takeaway: Keep iOS feel.
Trap: Over-customization makes List look un-native.

cards.title: List style
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Choose list styles that match the screen.
Takeaway: `.insetGrouped` etc.
Trap: Styles differ by platform; test on device.

cards.title: Navigation destination weight
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Keep destination creation cheap.
Takeaway: Fast tap response.
Trap: Heavy init work delays navigation.

cards.title: Lazy destination pattern
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Value-based navigation helps build destinations lazily.
Takeaway: Better performance.
Trap: Eagerly building complex destinations inside rows.

cards.title: Row performance
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Keep row views lightweight.
Takeaway: Smooth scrolling.
Trap: Networking inside row body causes repeated requests.

cards.title: Pull-to-refresh cancellation
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Support cancellation and prevent duplicate refreshes.
Takeaway: Efficient reload.
Trap: Each pull starting a new request leads to race bugs.

cards.title: Search + filters
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Treat filters as state.
Takeaway: Predictable query behavior.
Trap: Hidden filter variables lead to mismatched results.

cards.title: Interactive dismiss
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Sheets can be dismissed by swipe.
Takeaway: Default iOS behavior.
Trap: For critical flows, disable interactive dismiss.

cards.title: interactiveDismissDisabled
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `.interactiveDismissDisabled(true)` when necessary.
Takeaway: Prevent accidental close.
Trap: Overusing it frustrates users.

cards.title: Back button hiding
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Hiding back button needs an alternative exit.
Takeaway: Avoid trapping users.
Trap: “No way back” is a UX bug.

cards.title: Deep link safety
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Validate deep link data before navigating.
Takeaway: Avoid broken screens.
Trap: Navigating to missing data causes empty/crashy screens.

cards.title: Restoring navigation
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Persist only what you can safely restore.
Takeaway: Better UX.
Trap: Restoring a path to deleted content leads to dead ends.

cards.title: Accessibility in lists
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Group row content for VoiceOver.
Takeaway: Better accessibility.
Trap: Complex rows read poorly without labels/hints.

cards.title: Form save pattern
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Put Save/Done in the navigation bar.
Takeaway: Standard iOS UX.
Trap: Save enabled when invalid causes errors.

cards.title: Validation before save
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Validate inputs and disable save until valid.
Takeaway: Fewer errors.
Trap: Aggressive validation during typing can annoy users.

cards.title: Navigation state debugging
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Debug routing by inspecting path and selection.
Takeaway: Clear control.
Trap: When things break, it’s often “two sources of truth”.

modules.title: 14. Layout, Animations, Performance
modules.moduleDescription: Layout model, grids, GeometryReader, animations/transitions, and performance best practices.

cards.title: SwiftUI layout model
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Parent proposes a size, child chooses, parent positions.
Takeaway: This explains most layout surprises.
Trap: Thinking in absolute pixels instead of proposals/constraints.

cards.title: Intrinsic size
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Many views have intrinsic content size (Text, Image).
Takeaway: They choose a natural size.
Trap: Frames can override and cause truncation.

cards.title: frame min/ideal/max
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `frame(min:ideal:max:)` gives flexible sizing hints.
Takeaway: Use when you want adaptability.
Trap: Overusing maxWidth `.infinity` can break stacks.

cards.title: Layout, Animations, Performance — maxWidth .infinity
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Expands to fill available width.
Takeaway: Combine with alignment.
Trap: In HStack it can steal space from siblings.

cards.title: Alignment vs frame alignment
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Stack alignment differs from frame alignment.
Takeaway: Know which one you’re adjusting.
Trap: Setting alignment in the wrong place does nothing.

cards.title: Spacer vs frame
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use Spacer for flexible gaps, frame for constraints.
Takeaway: Spacers are often simpler.
Trap: Too many spacers create unpredictable layouts.

cards.title: layoutPriority
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Higher priority resists compression.
Takeaway: Keep important text visible.
Trap: Giving everything high priority cancels the benefit.

cards.title: fixedSize
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `fixedSize()` prevents a view from being compressed.
Takeaway: Useful for labels.
Trap: It can force overflow and break layouts.

cards.title: Text truncation
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `lineLimit` and `truncationMode`.
Takeaway: Predictable text behavior.
Trap: Fixed frames + large text often truncates unexpectedly.

cards.title: Multiline alignment
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `multilineTextAlignment` for text alignment.
Takeaway: Better readability.
Trap: It doesn’t control container alignment.

cards.title: GeometryReader caution
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: GeometryReader takes all available space.
Takeaway: Use locally, not as a root wrapper.
Trap: Wrapping whole screens with it often breaks layout.

cards.title: safeAreaInset
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `safeAreaInset` adds content at edges safely.
Takeaway: Great for sticky toolbars.
Trap: Manual padding + inset can double-space.

cards.title: ignoresSafeArea
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use ignoresSafeArea mostly for backgrounds.
Takeaway: Full-bleed designs.
Trap: Interactive controls under system UI is bad UX.

cards.title: ScrollView sizing
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Inside ScrollView, width may shrink to content.
Takeaway: Use maxWidth `.infinity` for full-width stacks.
Trap: Unexpected narrow content due to intrinsic sizing.

cards.title: Lazy stacks
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Lazy stacks render on demand.
Takeaway: Better for long scrolling content.
Trap: Heavy row content still causes jank.

cards.title: Grid basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use LazyVGrid/LazyHGrid for grids.
Takeaway: Great for cards.
Trap: Fixed column sizes break on different devices.

cards.title: Layout, Animations, Performance — Adaptive grid
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `.adaptive(minimum:)` chooses column count automatically.
Takeaway: Responsive grids.
Trap: Too small minimum creates too many columns.

cards.title: Aspect ratio
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `.aspectRatio(contentMode:)` preserves proportions.
Takeaway: Prevents distorted images.
Trap: Fill crops—clip if needed.

cards.title: clipShape vs mask
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: clipShape is usually cheaper than mask.
Takeaway: Use clipShape for rounded corners.
Trap: Masks can be expensive in lists.

cards.title: Shadows are expensive
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Shadows cost GPU time.
Takeaway: Use sparingly, especially in scrolling lists.
Trap: Shadow on every row can kill FPS.

cards.title: Blur is expensive
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Blur is heavier than shadows.
Takeaway: Use only when it adds real value.
Trap: Blur on moving content drains battery.

cards.title: Materials
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Materials (e.g., ultraThinMaterial) create glass effects.
Takeaway: Looks nice with system support.
Trap: Can be expensive on older devices.

cards.title: Animations are state changes
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Animation happens when state changes.
Takeaway: Animate state transitions.
Trap: Animating without changing state does nothing.

cards.title: Layout, Animations, Performance — withAnimation
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Wrap state changes in withAnimation.
Takeaway: Explicit animations.
Trap: Animating too many properties at once looks messy.

cards.title: Layout, Animations, Performance — .animation(value:)
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Attach animations to specific values.
Takeaway: Controlled behavior.
Trap: Global animation without value causes unexpected animations.

cards.title: Transaction
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Transactions can disable or customize animations.
Takeaway: Fix unwanted list animations.
Trap: Overusing transactions makes UI inconsistent.

cards.title: Disable animations
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `.transaction { $0.disablesAnimations = true }` when needed.
Takeaway: Stop unwanted transitions.
Trap: Disabling everywhere makes UI feel dead.

cards.title: Transitions require insert/remove
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Transitions only apply on insertion/removal.
Takeaway: Use conditional views.
Trap: Changing opacity isn’t a transition by itself.

cards.title: MatchedGeometryEffect
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Matched geometry animates between two views.
Takeaway: Great “hero” transitions.
Trap: Requires matching IDs and a shared namespace.

cards.title: Spring animations
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Springs feel natural for UI motion.
Takeaway: Use for small interactions.
Trap: Too bouncy feels gimmicky.

cards.title: Duration guidelines
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Keep animations short (~0.2–0.35s) for UI.
Takeaway: Snappy UX.
Trap: Long animations feel slow.

cards.title: Reduce Motion
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Respect the Reduce Motion accessibility setting.
Takeaway: Inclusive UX.
Trap: Forcing motion can harm some users.

cards.title: body must be cheap
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: body recomputes often—keep it lightweight.
Takeaway: Move work out of body.
Trap: Sorting/filtering in body for large arrays causes jank.

cards.title: Extract heavy computations
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use view models or precomputed values.
Takeaway: Smooth rendering.
Trap: Doing network or parsing in body is a bug.

cards.title: Stable IDs for performance
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Stable IDs improve diffing and animations.
Takeaway: Better list performance.
Trap: Random IDs cause constant view recreation.

cards.title: AnyView caution
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: AnyView erases type information.
Takeaway: Use only to solve type-branch issues.
Trap: Overuse reduces performance and compiler help.

cards.title: EquatableView
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: EquatableView can reduce re-renders.
Takeaway: Useful in hot areas.
Trap: Only helps if equality checks are meaningful and cheap.

cards.title: drawingGroup
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: drawingGroup can rasterize complex drawings.
Takeaway: Can improve performance in some cases.
Trap: Can also hurt—measure.

cards.title: Canvas
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Canvas is for custom drawing.
Takeaway: Powerful for graphs.
Trap: Frequent redraws drain battery.

cards.title: TimelineView
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: TimelineView updates at scheduled times.
Takeaway: Clocks and timed animations.
Trap: Updating too frequently wastes energy.

cards.title: Layout, Animations, Performance — Energy impact
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Frequent state updates cost battery.
Takeaway: Update only when needed.
Trap: Infinite animations in background are expensive.

cards.title: AsyncImage basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: AsyncImage is easy for simple remote images.
Takeaway: Fast prototype.
Trap: Limited caching/control—custom loaders for production.

cards.title: Image caching
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Cache images for smooth scrolling.
Takeaway: Avoid refetching.
Trap: Re-downloading per row kills performance.

cards.title: List cell work
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Keep row views simple.
Takeaway: Avoid heavy effects.
Trap: Complex shadows/blur per cell causes stutter.

cards.title: Batch state updates
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Update arrays in batches.
Takeaway: Fewer diffs.
Trap: Appending 100 items one by one can cause repeated renders.

cards.title: Avoid render loops
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Don’t set state from geometry/preference changes without guards.
Takeaway: Prevent infinite re-layout.
Trap: Layout → state → layout loops freeze UI.

cards.title: Debug layout
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use temporary borders/backgrounds to see frames.
Takeaway: Faster layout debugging.
Trap: Forgetting to remove debug styling.

cards.title: PreferenceKey caution
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: PreferenceKey is powerful but can cause loops.
Takeaway: Use carefully.
Trap: Setting state every preference change triggers more changes.

cards.title: List animations
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: List animations can be expensive on large diffs.
Takeaway: Consider disabling for big updates.
Trap: Over-animating makes UI feel jumpy.

cards.title: Matched geometry pitfalls
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: IDs and namespace must match across views.
Takeaway: Otherwise it won’t animate.
Trap: Duplicate IDs create weird results.

cards.title: Layout + Dynamic Type
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Plan layout for larger fonts.
Takeaway: Avoid fixed heights.
Trap: Fixed frames truncate accessibility text sizes.

cards.title: Content size category
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Test multiple content size categories.
Takeaway: Catch truncation early.
Trap: UI that works at default size may break for users.

cards.title: SafeArea and keyboards
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Forms should account for keyboards.
Takeaway: Avoid hidden inputs.
Trap: Ignoring keyboard leads to unreachable fields.

cards.title: Performance profiling
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use Instruments to profile.
Takeaway: Measure before optimizing.
Trap: Guessing leads to wasted time.

cards.title: GPU overdraw
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Too many layers/effects increase overdraw.
Takeaway: Simplify visuals in lists.
Trap: “Pretty” can become laggy.

cards.title: Reduce effects in scroll
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Avoid heavy effects inside scrolling containers.
Takeaway: Smooth scrolling.
Trap: Effects inside rows scale with item count.

cards.title: Animation scope
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Animate only what needs animation.
Takeaway: Better clarity.
Trap: Animating everything makes UI feel chaotic.

cards.title: Transition vs animation
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Transition is for enter/exit; animation is for changes.
Takeaway: Use the right tool.
Trap: Expecting transition on property changes.

cards.title: Avoid nested GeometryReader
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Nested geometry readers can become complex.
Takeaway: Prefer simpler layouts.
Trap: Complex geometry chains are hard to maintain.

cards.title: HStack compression
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: In HStack, views compete for width.
Takeaway: Use layoutPriority wisely.
Trap: A `.frame(maxWidth: .infinity)` child can starve others.

cards.title: Text baseline alignment
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use alignment guides/baseline alignment when needed.
Takeaway: Better typography.
Trap: Over-tuning alignment without need complicates code.

cards.title: Custom transitions caution
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Custom transitions can be expensive.
Takeaway: Keep them simple.
Trap: Complex transitions drop frames.

cards.title: Animation and state models
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Clean state models lead to clean animations.
Takeaway: Enums for state help.
Trap: Boolean soup causes conflicting animations.

cards.title: Core performance checklist
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Stable IDs, lightweight body, lazy containers, minimal blur/shadow.
Takeaway: Smooth UI.
Trap: Ignoring this leads to stutter and battery drain.

modules.title: 15. UIKit Fundamentals
modules.moduleDescription: UIViewController lifecycle, views, Auto Layout basics, controls, and UIKit patterns.

cards.title: Why UIKit still matters
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: UIKit powers many existing iOS apps and advanced UI cases.
Takeaway: Knowing UIKit is still valuable.
Trap: Assuming you can avoid UIKit in real projects.

cards.title: UIViewController role
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: View controllers manage view lifecycle and coordination.
Takeaway: They connect UI and logic.
Trap: Massive view controllers become unmaintainable.

cards.title: MVC in UIKit
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: UIKit projects often follow MVC.
Takeaway: Recognize patterns in existing codebases.
Trap: “Massive VC” is a common MVC failure mode.

cards.title: UIView basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: UI is a hierarchy of UIViews.
Takeaway: Parent/child order matters.
Trap: A view not in the hierarchy won’t appear.

cards.title: addSubview
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `view.addSubview(child)` attaches a view.
Takeaway: Then set constraints or a frame.
Trap: Without size/constraints, the view may be 0×0.

cards.title: View hierarchy order
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Later-added subviews appear on top.
Takeaway: Order affects layering.
Trap: Adding overlay views early can hide them under content.

cards.title: Auto Layout vs frames
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Don’t mix manual frames and Auto Layout casually.
Takeaway: Pick one approach for a view.
Trap: Constraints may override your frame changes.

cards.title: translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Set `translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false` for Auto Layout.
Takeaway: Prevents implicit constraints.
Trap: Forgetting this causes constraint conflicts.

cards.title: UIKit Fundamentals — Safe area
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Anchor to `safeAreaLayoutGuide`.
Takeaway: Avoid notches and bars.
Trap: Pinning to `view.topAnchor` can place content under the status bar.

cards.title: Lifecycle overview
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Key VC methods: `viewDidLoad`, `viewWillAppear`, `viewDidAppear`.
Takeaway: Each has a purpose.
Trap: Doing everything in one lifecycle method causes bugs.

cards.title: viewDidLoad
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Do one-time setup in `viewDidLoad`.
Takeaway: Configure views and bindings.
Trap: Layout isn’t final—don’t rely on frames here.

cards.title: viewWillAppear
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Refresh UI/state before the view appears.
Takeaway: Runs every time.
Trap: Heavy work here slows transitions.

cards.title: viewDidAppear
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Start animations or request permissions after the view is visible.
Takeaway: Best for user-facing prompts.
Trap: Presenting alerts too early can cause warnings.

cards.title: viewWillDisappear
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Stop timers, cancel tasks, and clean up.
Takeaway: Prevent wasted work.
Trap: Forgetting cleanup leads to leaks and stale callbacks.

cards.title: deinit as leak check
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: A dismissed/popped VC should deinit.
Takeaway: Log in deinit for leak detection.
Trap: If deinit doesn’t run, suspect a retain cycle.

cards.title: UINavigationController
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Nav controller manages a stack of view controllers.
Takeaway: Push/pop for hierarchy.
Trap: `navigationController` can be nil if not embedded.

cards.title: pushViewController
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `navigationController?.pushViewController(vc, animated: true)`.
Takeaway: Standard navigation.
Trap: If nav controller is nil, nothing happens.

cards.title: popViewController
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `popViewController` goes back.
Takeaway: Removes top VC.
Trap: Don’t call pop when not in a nav stack.

cards.title: present (modal)
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `present(vc, animated: true)` shows a modal.
Takeaway: Use for non-hierarchical flows.
Trap: Presenting multiple modals at once causes warnings.

cards.title: UIKit Fundamentals — dismiss
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `dismiss(animated: true)` closes a modal.
Takeaway: Returns to presenter.
Trap: Dismiss doesn’t pop navigation stack VCs.

cards.title: Tab bar basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: UITabBarController switches between root sections.
Takeaway: Good top-level navigation.
Trap: Putting deep flows as separate tabs can confuse UX.

cards.title: Auto Layout goal
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Constraints describe relationships, not absolute positions.
Takeaway: Adapts to devices.
Trap: Missing constraints cause ambiguous layout.

cards.title: Constraint completeness
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Define position and size (or enough relations).
Takeaway: Avoid ambiguity.
Trap: “It looks fine” can break on different screens.

cards.title: Leading/trailing
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Prefer leading/trailing over left/right.
Takeaway: Supports RTL languages.
Trap: left/right break localization layouts.

cards.title: Content Hugging
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Hugging resists stretching.
Takeaway: Labels keep natural width.
Trap: Ignoring hugging leads to weird expansions.

cards.title: Compression Resistance
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Compression resistance resists shrinking.
Takeaway: Important text stays visible.
Trap: Low resistance can truncate critical labels.

cards.title: UILabel multiline
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Set `numberOfLines = 0` for multiline labels.
Takeaway: Auto Layout can size height.
Trap: Without it, text truncates to one line.

cards.title: UIButton target-action
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `addTarget(_:action:for:)`.
Takeaway: Standard event handling.
Trap: Selector signature must match and be @objc.

cards.title: Control events
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use correct UIControl events (e.g., `.touchUpInside`).
Takeaway: Predictable interaction.
Trap: Wrong event = handler never fires.

cards.title: UITextField delegates
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: UITextField uses delegates for behavior and return key.
Takeaway: Handle editing events.
Trap: Forgetting to set delegate means callbacks won’t happen.

cards.title: UITextView basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: UITextView is multiline text input.
Takeaway: Good for notes.
Trap: It scrolls by default—plan layout accordingly.

cards.title: Delegation pattern
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Delegates are a core UIKit pattern.
Takeaway: Use `weak` delegates.
Trap: Strong delegates create retain cycles.

cards.title: UIStackView
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Stack views simplify layouts.
Takeaway: Fewer constraints.
Trap: Stack views don’t draw background—wrap in a container view.

cards.title: Stack distribution
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Distribution controls spacing sizing.
Takeaway: `fill`, `fillEqually`, etc.
Trap: `fillEqually` can break for variable content.

cards.title: Stack alignment
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Alignment controls cross-axis alignment.
Takeaway: Center vs leading, etc.
Trap: Confusing alignment with distribution leads to layout confusion.

cards.title: viewDidLayoutSubviews
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Frames are final after layout in `viewDidLayoutSubviews`.
Takeaway: Safe place to read sizes.
Trap: Changing constraints repeatedly here can create loops.

cards.title: setNeedsLayout
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Requests layout update later.
Takeaway: Coalesced updates.
Trap: Calling it in tight loops wastes CPU.

cards.title: layoutIfNeeded
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Forces layout now.
Takeaway: Useful for constraint animations.
Trap: Overusing it harms performance.

cards.title: Animating constraints
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Change constraint constants then animate `layoutIfNeeded()`.
Takeaway: Smooth transitions.
Trap: Forgetting to call layoutIfNeeded inside animation block.

cards.title: UIScrollView basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Scroll views need content size or constraints.
Takeaway: Use contentLayoutGuide/frameLayoutGuide.
Trap: Incorrect constraints cause no scrolling or weird bouncing.

cards.title: Keyboard handling
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Adjust scroll insets for keyboard.
Takeaway: Keep fields visible.
Trap: Not handling keyboard makes forms unusable.

cards.title: Keyboard notifications
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Listen for keyboard show/hide when needed.
Takeaway: Update insets.
Trap: Forgetting to remove observers in legacy APIs.

cards.title: Appearance APIs
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use UINavigationBarAppearance for consistent styling.
Takeaway: Modern approach.
Trap: Not setting scrollEdgeAppearance yields inconsistent styles.

cards.title: Trait collection
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Traits change with size class and dark mode.
Takeaway: Adapt layouts.
Trap: Ignoring iPad split view causes broken UI.

cards.title: Dynamic Type in UIKit
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `preferredFont` and enable adjustsFontForContentSizeCategory.
Takeaway: Accessibility.
Trap: Fixed font sizes break for large text users.

cards.title: System colors
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use system colors for dark mode.
Takeaway: Automatic adaptation.
Trap: Hardcoded colors can become unreadable in dark mode.

cards.title: Hit testing
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Some views default to `isUserInteractionEnabled = false` (e.g., UIImageView).
Takeaway: Enable interaction if needed.
Trap: Gesture recognizers won’t fire otherwise.

cards.title: Gesture recognizers
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Gestures add interactions without subclassing.
Takeaway: Tap, pan, etc.
Trap: Gesture conflicts with scroll views need careful handling.

cards.title: Constraints debugging
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use breakpoint `UIViewAlertForUnsatisfiableConstraints`.
Takeaway: Catch conflicts early.
Trap: Ignoring Auto Layout logs wastes hours.

cards.title: Ambiguous layout
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Ambiguous means not enough constraints.
Takeaway: Add missing constraints.
Trap: It may look okay on one device but break on another.

cards.title: Shadow vs masksToBounds
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: If `masksToBounds` is true, shadow won’t show.
Takeaway: Use a container view for shadows.
Trap: Trying to do shadow + clipping on one layer fails.

cards.title: Performance basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Transparency, shadows, and masks cost GPU time.
Takeaway: Keep layers simple in scroll.
Trap: Fancy effects in lists destroy FPS.

cards.title: Storyboard vs code
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: UIKit UIs can be storyboard-based or code-based.
Takeaway: Learn to read both.
Trap: Mixed approaches can confuse ownership of constraints/outlets.

cards.title: XIB/NIB basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: XIBs are reusable view layouts.
Takeaway: Useful for custom cells.
Trap: Outlet connections can break during refactors.

cards.title: View controller containment
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: You can embed child VCs properly.
Takeaway: Modular UIs.
Trap: Forgetting `addChild`/`didMove` breaks lifecycle.

cards.title: Proper containment steps
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `addChild`, add view, set constraints, `didMove`.
Takeaway: Correct lifecycle.
Trap: Skipping `didMove` causes missing callbacks.

cards.title: Avoid heavy work on main
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Heavy work should run off main.
Takeaway: Keep scrolling smooth.
Trap: JSON parsing on main causes frame drops.

cards.title: Dependency injection
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Inject dependencies into VCs.
Takeaway: Testable, explicit.
Trap: Using singletons everywhere hides dependencies.

cards.title: Memory checklist
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Weak delegates, weak self in closures, invalidate timers, cancel tasks.
Takeaway: Prevent leaks.
Trap: Leaks often show up only after repeated navigation.

modules.title: 16. UIKit Lists + Navigation + Delegates
modules.moduleDescription: UITableView/UICollectionView, reuse, diffable data source, navigation, delegates, and crash traps.

cards.title: UITableView purpose
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: UITableView is optimized for vertical lists.
Takeaway: Use it for feeds, settings, and simple lists.
Trap: Rebuilding lists with ScrollView + stacks is slower and more complex.

cards.title: DataSource vs Delegate
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: DataSource provides data; Delegate handles behavior/events.
Takeaway: Separate responsibilities.
Trap: Forgetting to set either results in an empty or unresponsive table.

cards.title: Register cells
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Register cells before dequeueing.
Takeaway: Avoid runtime crashes.
Trap: Wrong reuseIdentifier causes a crash at dequeue time.

cards.title: dequeueReusableCell
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Always dequeue cells by identifier.
Takeaway: Reuse improves performance.
Trap: Creating new cells manually breaks reuse and performance.

cards.title: ReuseIdentifier constant
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Keep reuse identifiers as constants.
Takeaway: Avoid typos.
Trap: String literals scattered across files cause subtle bugs.

cards.title: Cell configuration
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Configure every visible property each time.
Takeaway: Reuse means old content can linger.
Trap: Not resetting state causes “ghost” UI in reused cells.

cards.title: prepareForReuse
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Override `prepareForReuse()` to reset.
Takeaway: Clear old images/async work.
Trap: Forgetting cancel leads to wrong images flashing.

cards.title: Async images + reuse
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Image loads must account for cell reuse.
Takeaway: Associate requests with model IDs.
Trap: Late responses can set the wrong image.

cards.title: Cancel image requests
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Cancel in-flight loads when a cell is reused.
Takeaway: Less bandwidth and fewer glitches.
Trap: Without cancel, scrolling triggers a storm of requests.

cards.title: Dynamic cell height
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use Auto Layout + `automaticDimension`.
Takeaway: Self-sizing cells.
Trap: Missing bottom constraints gives wrong heights.

cards.title: estimatedRowHeight
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Provide estimated heights for performance.
Takeaway: Faster initial layout.
Trap: Bad estimates can cause jumpy scrolling.

cards.title: didSelectRowAt
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Handle selection in `didSelectRowAt`.
Takeaway: Navigate or act.
Trap: Forgetting to deselect keeps row highlighted.

cards.title: deselectRow
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Call `deselectRow(at:animated:)` after selection.
Takeaway: Standard iOS behavior.
Trap: Leaving selection highlighted looks buggy.

cards.title: Swipe to delete
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Implement delete via editingStyle or swipe actions.
Takeaway: Native UX.
Trap: Must update the backing data source or you crash.

cards.title: Edit mode
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use editing mode for delete/reorder.
Takeaway: Familiar UI.
Trap: Enabling editing without implementing move/delete does nothing.

cards.title: Reorder rows
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Implement `moveRowAt` and update data.
Takeaway: Persist order changes.
Trap: If you don’t update the model, it snaps back.

cards.title: reloadData costs
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: `reloadData()` is simple but heavy.
Takeaway: Use sparingly.
Trap: Frequent reloads cause flicker and lost scroll position.

cards.title: Batch updates
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use `performBatchUpdates` or table updates for inserts/deletes.
Takeaway: Smooth animations.
Trap: UI and data must match exactly or you crash.

cards.title: Diffable data source
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use UITableViewDiffableDataSource for safer updates.
Takeaway: Fewer update crashes.
Trap: Item identifiers must be unique and stable.

cards.title: Snapshot apply
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Apply snapshots on the main thread.
Takeaway: Correct UI updates.
Trap: Applying from background can cause warnings/crashes.

cards.title: Stable IDs
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use stable IDs (server ID) for diffing.
Takeaway: Correct animations.
Trap: New UUIDs every refresh breaks diffing.

cards.title: UITableView vs UICollectionView
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Table for simple lists; Collection for grids/custom layouts.
Takeaway: Pick the right tool.
Trap: Forcing table to behave like a grid is painful.

cards.title: UICollectionView basics
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Collection view uses cells + a layout.
Takeaway: Highly flexible.
Trap: Incorrect layout sizing causes overlapping or empty views.

cards.title: Flow layout
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: UICollectionViewFlowLayout is the basic layout.
Takeaway: Great for grids.
Trap: Misconfigured itemSize/spacing leads to bad UI.

cards.title: Compositional layout
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Compositional layout supports complex section layouts.
Takeaway: App Store-like screens.
Trap: Overkill for simple grids—start simpler.

cards.title: Register collection cells
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Register cells and supplementary views.
Takeaway: Avoid dequeue crashes.
Trap: Forgetting to register headers/footers crashes at runtime.

cards.title: Supplementary views
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use supplementary views for section headers/footers.
Takeaway: Better structure.
Trap: Wrong kind identifier causes dequeue failures.

cards.title: Prefetching
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Prefetch data/images to improve scroll performance.
Takeaway: Load ahead of time.
Trap: Prefetch without cancel wastes bandwidth.

cards.title: Pagination trigger
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Trigger pagination near the end of data.
Takeaway: Infinite scroll.
Trap: Triggering multiple times causes duplicate requests.

cards.title: Deduplicate pages
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Deduplicate items by ID when appending pages.
Takeaway: Avoid duplicate rows.
Trap: Duplicate IDs break diffable snapshots.

cards.title: IndexPath meaning
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: IndexPath is (section, row/item).
Takeaway: Understand both components.
Trap: Mixing row and section indexes causes wrong data access.

cards.title: Sections model
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Model sections explicitly.
Takeaway: Cleaner data source.
Trap: Deriving sections ad-hoc in cellForRow leads to bugs.

cards.title: Navigation push from list
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Push detail VC on selection.
Takeaway: Standard list → detail.
Trap: Presenting modals for detail screens hurts navigation UX.

cards.title: Passing data
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Pass data through initializers or properties.
Takeaway: Clear ownership.
Trap: Using globals/singletons for passing data creates hidden coupling.

cards.title: Delegates for callbacks
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use delegates to send events back.
Takeaway: Classic UIKit pattern.
Trap: Delegates must be weak to avoid retain cycles.

cards.title: Closure callbacks
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Closures can replace delegates for simple callbacks.
Takeaway: Less boilerplate.
Trap: Stored closures can retain self and leak.

cards.title: NotificationCenter caution
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Notifications are global and hard to track.
Takeaway: Use sparingly.
Trap: Overuse becomes an untyped event bus.

cards.title: Coordinator pattern
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Coordinators move navigation out of VCs.
Takeaway: Thinner controllers.
Trap: Coordinators can grow into god objects too—keep them small.

cards.title: Modal styles
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: iOS 13+ defaults to pageSheet.
Takeaway: New modal behavior.
Trap: Expecting fullScreen without setting it.

cards.title: Force fullScreen
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Set `modalPresentationStyle = .fullScreen` if needed.
Takeaway: Legacy full-screen modals.
Trap: Full-screen for every modal can feel heavy.

cards.title: Sheet detents
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: UISheetPresentationController supports detents.
Takeaway: Modern sheet UX.
Trap: Requires iOS version checks.

cards.title: Threading UI updates
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Update UI only on main thread.
Takeaway: Avoid crashes.
Trap: Background callbacks calling table updates directly.

cards.title: Cell self-sizing constraints
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Self-sizing needs constraints from top to bottom.
Takeaway: Auto height works.
Trap: Missing bottom constraint breaks sizing.

cards.title: Estimated sizes tuning
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Tune estimated sizes for performance.
Takeaway: Smoother scrolling.
Trap: Wrong estimates cause jumping.

cards.title: Avoid per-cell network calls
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Don’t start a network call in each cell.
Takeaway: Prefetch or batch.
Trap: One request per row kills performance.

cards.title: Cache images
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Cache images to avoid refetching.
Takeaway: Smooth scrolling.
Trap: Not caching causes flicker and bandwidth waste.

cards.title: State belongs in model
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Cells should be dumb views; state belongs in the model.
Takeaway: Predictable reuse.
Trap: Storing selection state in cells breaks on reuse.

cards.title: Accessory types
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use accessory types (disclosure indicators) appropriately.
Takeaway: Native cues.
Trap: Putting disclosure on non-navigating rows misleads users.

cards.title: UIKit Lists + Navigation + Delegates — Context menus
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Context menus are for secondary actions.
Takeaway: Keep primary actions visible.
Trap: Context menus can conflict with swipe actions.

cards.title: Drag & drop
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Drag and drop can be supported in lists.
Takeaway: Great UX for rearranging.
Trap: Complex and time-consuming—only add when needed.

cards.title: Diffable + pagination
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Append items and apply a new snapshot.
Takeaway: Smooth incremental updates.
Trap: Rebuilding entire snapshot too often can be slow.

cards.title: Batch update crash trap
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Update model first, then update UI to match.
Takeaway: Prevent “invalid update” crashes.
Trap: Mismatch between number of rows and data causes crashes.

cards.title: scrollToRow timing
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Call scrollToRow after the table has data/layout.
Takeaway: Often after reload/layout pass.
Trap: Calling too early can do nothing or crash.

cards.title: Empty state UI
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Show a placeholder when list is empty.
Takeaway: Better UX.
Trap: Empty list looks like a bug.

cards.title: Skeleton loading
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Skeletons improve perceived performance.
Takeaway: Users see progress.
Trap: Over-complicated skeletons aren’t worth it.

cards.title: Testing data sources
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Test snapshot generation and section models.
Takeaway: Prevent regressions.
Trap: Only manual testing misses edge cases.

cards.title: MVVM for lists
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use view models to prepare cell view data.
Takeaway: Thinner controllers.
Trap: View model should not import UIKit.

cards.title: Cell view models
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use lightweight cell models.
Takeaway: Easy configuration.
Trap: Passing huge domain objects into cells leads to coupling.

cards.title: Back communication
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Detail edits should notify list to update.
Takeaway: Delegate/closure.
Trap: Forgetting to update the source data causes UI drift.

cards.title: Reload vs insert/delete
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Prefer incremental updates over full reload.
Takeaway: Less flicker.
Trap: Incorrect incremental updates cause crashes—diffable helps.

cards.title: beginUpdates/endUpdates
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Use begin/end updates for height changes.
Takeaway: Animated layout updates.
Trap: Data mismatches still crash—be careful.

cards.title: Performance checklist
cards.cardDescription:
Rule: Reuse cells, stable IDs, batch updates, cache images.
Takeaway: Smooth scrolling.
Trap: Per-cell work scales with list size.
